title: Emrys and the Safehouse
author: Gideon Lockridge
blurb: Oscar Sandoval, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
